title: Which untreated person is a twin?
hook: Compare people at the same measured age before averaging outcomes.

knows: arithmetic means, rates and simple plotted values
doesNotKnow: dots for treated and untreated people pair up by age and income, and lines connect the matches.

misconception: Treating find each one's twin as valid without checking the stated model, denominators or causal assumptions.
objective: dots for treated and untreated people pair up by age and income, and lines connect the matches.
keyState: Both finite cases completed; their computed summaries retained.

claims.text: Treated people aged 60 and 20 have outcomes 80 and 60. Untreated people aged 20, 60, 90 have outcomes 50, 70, 10. What mean difference follows exact-age matching?
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-find-each-one-s-twin/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Treated outcomes [80,60] at ages [60,20]; untreated outcomes [50,70,10] at ages [20,60,90]. Match by exact age: effects 10 and 10. Unmatched means 70 vs 43.3333 exaggerate to 26.6667.

claims.text: The matched difference is 10; using every control gives 26.667. Matching uses the same ages instead of letting the unmatched 90-year-old change the comparison.
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-find-each-one-s-twin/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Treated outcomes [80,60] at ages [60,20]; untreated outcomes [50,70,10] at ages [20,60,90]. Match by exact age: effects 10 and 10. Unmatched means 70 vs 43.3333 exaggerate to 26.6667.

claims.text: Matching can improve comparability on measured variables. It identifies a treatment effect only with adequate overlap and no remaining unmeasured confounding; a neat pair of dots does not establish those assumptions.
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-find-each-one-s-twin/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Treated outcomes [80,60] at ages [60,20]; untreated outcomes [50,70,10] at ages [20,60,90]. Match by exact age: effects 10 and 10. Unmatched means 70 vs 43.3333 exaggerate to 26.6667.

claims.text: At the same measured age, treated outcomes are 9 and 7, matched controls 6 and 6. What mean difference remains? The matched differences are 3 and 1, averaging 2.
